DHAMMA YAMAKA—PAIRS ON DHAMMAS Faultless dhamma had not arisen at this person at this plane. Will indeterminate dhamma not cease at that person at that plane? (They) will cease. Indeterminate dhamma will not cease at this person at this plane. Had faultless dhamma not arisen at that person at that plane? (They) had arisen. 228. Un-faultless dhamma had not arisen at this person at this plane. Will indeterminate dhamma not cease at that person at that plane? (They) will cease. Indeterminate dhamma will not cease at this person at this plane. Had un-faultless dhamma not arisen at that person at that plane? (They) had arisen.
